The package version is "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"0.12.0, but it has not been published. The current public stable release is v0.11.2; the installatio"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"n examples below still refer to that release."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Deterministic Chinese task routing, path-aware identifier detection and source-first candidate sel"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ection improve Context Packs while retaining English task regressions.
- Optional `ContextPack.evide"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"nce` describes indexed-file diagnostics, static relationship grades, candidate tests and detected ga"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ps. `parsed` is not semantic completeness; zero static callers does not prove there are no callers.
"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"- Evidence may be compacted or omitted under the same text/JSON budget. Missing optional evidence me"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"ans **not provided**, not “no gaps.” Default 5000 and 300–20000 character bounds remain unchanged.
-"},{"id":"p6s7","text":" Test associations are leads, not execution, passing tests or verified coverage. Real Agent validati"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"on is a separate release gate; unexecuted or blocked runs are never counted as passed."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"See the candidate integration record and M2 evidence contract for actual methods, outcomes and limit"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"e the candidate integration record and M2 evidence contract for actual methods, outcomes and limits."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The final release-blocker check records normal npm peer resolution and bounded real-Agent rechecks. "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"Future RC groups are not automatically treated as verified."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Impact X-Ray"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**See the blast radius before your AI edits the code.**"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"A local DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that turns a code diff into an inspectable map of potentially "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"affected callers, imports and test leads. Until v0.12.0 is published, install the stable **v0.11.2** in a compatible DSH profile:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Restart Desktop after installation. v0.11.1 declares DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.3`"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" host groups; for Desktop rc.3, the compatibility warning was reported gone, but full Electron Deskt"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"op feature and Agent acceptance is not claimed. Install details · v0.11.1 verification and limits."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**Watch the 30-second real Desktop demo:** a change to `normalize()` → inspect callers and a test le"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ad → click a relationship to see the actual source location."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## More capabilities"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The index builds lazily on first use; later calls are served from the on-disk cache with mtime-incre"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"s lazily on first use; later calls are served from the on-disk cache with mtime-incremental refresh."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **Index build** (`src/buildIndex.ts`): recursive scan (excludes applied), per-file tree-sitter ext"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"raction (`src/extract.ts`), JSON cache under `<repo>/.dsh-code-index/`, incremental refresh by mtime"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" (only touched files re-parse).
- **Search** (`src/search.ts`): pure scoring — exact `1` / prefix `0"},{"id":"p20s4","text":".8` / substring `0.5`, export boost, name order tiebreak.
- **Repo map** (`src/repomap.ts`): persona"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"lized PageRank over the import graph (teleport = per-file density share, so hub files that are thems"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"elves imported by other hubs rise above flat in-degree counting), seeded by the density-aware file s"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"core (class/interface/function weighted, test paths damped), top-N files, per-file symbol cap, hard "},{"id":"p20s8","text":"char truncation.
- **Call graph** (`src/refgraph.ts`): call sites extracted per file (per language, "},{"id":"p20s9","text":"with their enclosing function) are resolved by name into callers and callees — `code_refs` exposes t"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"his directly, and `code_search` uses call fan-in as a ranking tie-break.
- **Change context** (`src/"},{"id":"p20s11","text":"change-context.ts`): maps Git hunks to stable symbols, then follows bounded provenance-labeled calle"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"rs, import dependents, entry paths, impact, and likely affected tests without returning the whole re"},{"id":"p20s13","text":"pository.
- **ContextPack** (`src/context.ts`, `src/context-pack.ts`, `src/source-excerpts.ts`): ran"},{"id":"p20s14","text":"ks task candidates, reads ephemeral source evidence, selects a final DTO under text/JSON budgets, th"},{"id":"p20s15","text":"en renders only selected items.
- **Health** (`src/health.ts`): Tarjan SCC over the import graph yie"},{"id":"p20s16","text":"lds circular dependencies; orphan-module detection lists symbol-bearing files with no inbound or out"},{"id":"p20s17","text":"bound imports (entry points and tests excluded).
- **Workspace resolution**: each tool resolves the "},{"id":"p20s18","text":"session cwd (`agent.session.header.cwd`) and walks up to the nearest `.git` (bounded — a directory w"},{"id":"p20s19","text":"ithout a repo marker is never indexed).
- **Project contexts** (`src/repo-context.ts`): canonical re"},{"id":"p20s20","text":"al paths identify separate worktrees; up to four contexts are retained. Each tool call scans current"},{"id":"p20s21","text":" metadata and reparses only changed files, while the watcher refreshes dirty files after a bounded d"},{"id":"p20s22","text":"arses only changed files, while the watcher refreshes dirty files after a bounded debounce.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **web-tree-sitter pinned to `^0.25` (ESM)** — the 0.25 line uses ESM named exports (`Language`/`Qu"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ery`); this pairing with `tree-sitter-wasms` static builds is verified working under Node ≥ 22/24.
-"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" Auto-injected maps use DSH's system-prompt assembly context for the active session. Agentless assem"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"bly falls back to the DSH process working directory. A newly accessed project may have an empty map "},{"id":"p22s5","text":"on its first prompt while indexing completes; following assemblies receive its map.
- The watcher st"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"arts only for projects accessed by a tool and is disposed with the plugin. With `externalWatch: fals"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"e`, per-call metadata scans still detect ordinary mtime changes.
- Large monorepos still require a d"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"irectory metadata scan on each tool call. File parsing is incremental, but scan latency depends on r"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"epository size and storage speed.
- Function-local variables are excluded. Module declarations and c"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"lass members are indexed; a parser/graph is not a type checker.
- Source reads reject files changed "},{"id":"p22s11","text":"after the index snapshot, paths resolving outside the root, and current files over 1 MB. Signature-o"},{"id":"p22s12","text":"nly fallbacks and gaps identify missing evidence; likely tests are leads, not proof of coverage."}],"truncated":true}
